content: Rey Miguel is a brand of hand-crafted premium cigars that is owned by the Black Cat Cigar Company, which is based in Philadelphia, Pennsylvania. The brand was originally created by José Pepin Garcia and is produced at the El Rey de los Habanos factory, located in the Little Havana neighborhood of Miami, Florida. This cigar is classified as medium-bodied. The filler tobacco used in the cigar is a blend of Nicaraguan tobaccos. The binder used in the cigar is not disclosed. The wrapper is a Connecticut-seed wrapper that is cultivated by Silvio and Alfredo Perez in Ecuador. This specific wrapper is known to moderate the strength and body of the Nicaraguan filler blend, creating a balanced smoking experience.
